detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Incoming transmission...

From beyond the familiar skies of Löckelle...

An accident during a routine mission to test the new Quilez thrusters for single-person space travel, a solo Löckonaut stranded very far from Löckelle. This is where the Eco-Friendly Operations Corporation claims to have discovered the ultimate solution to waste disposal, at least according to them.

Team up with Tier-1 and Mainframe, the last of the rebel crew, as you embark on a mission to stop E.F.O. Corp. before they destroy the planet with their artificial black hole waste disposal system.

FEATURES

  • Encounter space anomalies like gravity-changing crystals and the concerning threat of an artificial black hole.

  • Extraterrestrial maps to explore-and-escape from.

  • Equip your spacesuit and use the new tools for traversal and destruction.

  • Meet your loyal companion, Tier-1, and forge a friendship that just might save the galaxy.
